🍱 Ready Meals — Nutrition Tracking

Track what you eat instantly using AI-powered food recognition and nutrition analysis.

What This Feature Does

If your meal is already cooked, simply take a photo. SeeFood detects the food, estimates portion size, calculates calories, and provides a full nutrition breakdown.

How It Works

  1. Take a photo of your meal
  2. AI detects food items and portion size
  3. Nutrition values are calculated instantly
  4. Your meal is saved in your daily tracker

Why It’s Useful

  • Know exactly what you eat
  • Track calories without manual logging
  • Build healthier eating habits
